mapper.select: SELECT r.RECV_NO, r.PLAN_NO, r.ITEM_CD, r.ACTUAL_QTY, r.INSPECT_RESULT, i.ITEM_NM FROM RECV_RSLT r JOIN ITEM_MST i ON r.ITEM_CD = i.ITEM_CD WHERE r.PLAN_NO = #{planNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECV_RSLT (RECV_NO, PLAN_NO, ITEM_CD, ACTUAL_QTY, INSPECT_RESULT) VALUES (#{recvNo}, #{planNo}, #{itemCd}, #{actualQty}, #{inspectResult})
